methods.label: Coordinate reflections and triangle area
methods.explanation: \(B(-2,-3)\) and \(C(2,3)\). \(AB\) is perpendicular to the \(x\)-axis and has length 6; \(AC\) is parallel to the \(x\)-axis and has length 4. Since \(\angle A=90^\circ\), the area is \(6\times4\div2=12\).
